Meanwhile, Russia has begun a three-day parliamentary election - the first since its 2022 invasion of Ukraine - with only parties supporting the war allowed on the ballot; United Russia, which won more than two-thirds of seats in 2021, is expected to retain its dominance amid signs of economic strain among voters, and has used celebrities like NHL star Alex Ovechkin in its campaign.
